card.name: Capital S starting names
card.fires_on: The letter S (or a short opening piece like Boeh or Fo) that begins a proper name, such as a species, a German place name or an Arabic surname. It also fires at the start of a sentence or a brand name.

modes.label: S in place and species names
modes.description: A capital S begins a place or animal name, often Sankt or Squirrel.

modes.label: S in personal names
modes.description: An S or a short opening piece begins a surname in a name or citation.
modes.example: Schuhmann, E.,<< Fo>>ote, R., Eyberg, S

modes.label: S in brand names
modes.description: An S begins the second part of a drug brand name.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about pace and rhythm and away from words starting with tem, which is a weak and unclear link.
card.plain: It fires on a lone capital S that starts a name, like Sankt or Squirrel.
